问题是"Dog Fight"就字面意义来看怎么也不会和"缠斗"联系到一起. 
 
a close-range aerial combat between military aircraft, originated during World War I, and probably deriving from the preferred fighter tactic of positioning one's aircraft behind the enemy aircraft. From this position, a pilot could fire his guns on the enemy without having to lead the target, and the enemy aircraft could not effectively fire back. When two fighter aircraft circle each other trying to achieve this position, it resembles two dogs chasing each other's tails. 
军用飞机之间的近距离空战。该词起源于一战期间，当时通常的战术是将飞机置于敌机后方。在这一位置开火，敌机无法有效地反击。当双方周旋试图取得该位置时，其情节好像两只狗互相追逐对方的尾巴 
 
dogfight 
 n. 
混战, 空战, 狗咬狗 
vi. 
 
而且这词的来源也的确和狗有关,中文翻译为"狗斗",无论是直译还是意译都是十分的贴切的.
